description: Read the owner-approved architecture target or safely bootstrap one. With action=preview, returns an adaptive candidate, observed-but-not-enforced dependency directions, verification, exact file content/hash and a short-lived confirmation token. action=approve creates the local contract only after explicit token confirmation and never overwrites an active target.

action.description: Omit to read; preview is dry-run only; approve requires the preview token

baseline_mode.description: Whether preview should materialize current violations as an explicit ratchet baseline

candidate_contract.description: Optional reviewed candidate to normalize and verify during preview

confirm_token.description: One-time token returned by preview; required for approve

output_format.description: text returns only the concise TextContent summary; json also returns and mirrors the stable structuredContent envelope

name: get_architecture_contract
